options.name: description
options.description: The description field of the password you wish to create. (Optional)

options.name: encrypt_description
options.description: Option to create the password description as a secret and encrypt it in the database. (Optional. Defaults to true.)

options.name: fingerprint
options.description: The fingerprint of the imported Private key used to access Passbolt.

options.name: gpgkey
options.description: The GPG Private key used to access Passbolt.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the password you wish to create.

options.name: passbolt_uri
options.description: The Passbolt instance Fully Qualified Domain Name(FQDN)

options.name: passphrase
options.description: The Passphrase used with the GPG Private key used to access Passbolt.

options.name: password
options.description: The password you wish to create.

options.name: uri
options.description: The uri field of the password you wish to create. (Optional)

options.name: username
options.description: The username field of the password you wish to create. (Optional but strongly encouraged.)

options.name: verify
options.description: Whether to verify SSL or not. (Defaults to verify)
